profile.input_contract: JSON params with mesh and coefficient fields.
profile.output_contract: JSON metrics consumed by typed verifier.

mrs.description: Superposition / linearity MP_mono: the 1D Poisson equation -u'' = f is linear in the source f. Scaling f by factor > 1 must strictly increase the peak amplitude u_max (and in fact scale it by the same factor exactly).

explanation_profile.meta_pattern_rationale: Mono MR: Superposition / linearity MP_mono: the 1D Poisson equation -u'' = f is linear in the source f.
explanation_profile.transformation_semantics: Apply ScaleField via transform steps [ScaleField@/source/strength] to derive follow-up input while preserving unrelated fields.
explanation_profile.observable_summary: Observe `u_max` from source and follow-up outputs for MR `poisson-source-superposition`.
explanation_profile.predicate_summary: Predicate `greater` / `GreaterThan` checks the expected relation on `u_max`.
explanation_profile.tolerance_summary: Ordinal predicate: no numeric tolerance is applied beyond the declared ordering relation.
explanation_profile.applicability: Applicable when SUT `poisson-1d` exposes sample `sample/standard.json`, the transform target fields, and output `u_max`; otherwise not applicable.
explanation_profile.failure_meaning: Failure indicates the SUT output, adapter mapping, or predicate evidence disagrees with the declared metamorphic expectation.

mrs.description: Mesh-refinement Richardson convergence MP_conv: doubling num_points (halving the FD spacing dx) must leave u_max within O(dx²) FD truncation tolerance — the second-order central-difference scheme is already at the fine-mesh plateau.
